source_refs.note: Topic 30.4 heading with an overview of 30.4.1 to 30.4.3 (PDF 206).

blocks.text: A 1H NMR spectrum is interpreted in two stages. A low-resolution spectrum (30.4.1) gives the number of proton environments, their types and the relative numbers of protons; a high-resolution spectrum (30.4.2) also shows how each peak is split by neighbouring protons. O-H and N-H protons are identified by a special test (30.4.3).

blocks.prompt: Which kind of 1H NMR spectrum shows the splitting of peaks by neighbouring protons?

items: Low resolution: number, type and relative numbers of protons; high resolution adds splitting.
